resources.string: BlueTap will provide one-tap home-screen widgets for connecting and disconnecting your paired Bluetooth audio devices.
To use a device, add a BlueTap widget to your home screen and choose the device for it. Connecting and disconnecting is not available yet.
Choose a paired Bluetooth device for this widget.
No paired devices. Pair a device in Bluetooth settings, then return here.
Allow Nearby devices to see your paired Bluetooth devices. You can also enable this permission in app settings.
Turn on Bluetooth in settings to see your paired devices.
Bluetooth is not available on this device.
Paired devices could not be read. Try refreshing the list.
Settings could not be opened on this device.
Connect or disconnect a paired Bluetooth device with one tap
